WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS now_ms)
         SELECT coalesce((
             SELECT (j.scheduled_at_ms - (SELECT now_ms FROM clock))::text
             FROM mesh_jobs.queues q JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j

             END FROM mesh_jobs.schema_version CROSS JOIN functions WHERE singleton

    SELECT namespace, id, run, worker, version, queue, state, priority, attempt, max_attempts,
        timeout_ms, backoff_base_ms, backoff_max_ms, inserted_at_ms, scheduled_at_ms,
        attempted_at_ms, finished_at_ms, lease_expires_at_ms, cancel_requested_at_ms,
        id::text || '/' || run::text AS effect_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER mesh_jobs_queue_wake
    AFTER UPDATE OF state, concurrency ON mesh_jobs.queues
    FOR EACH ROW WHEN (
        lower(current_setting('mesh_jobs.publish_wakeups', true)) IN ('on', 'true', '1')
        AND NEW.state = 'active' AND (NEW.concurrency > 0 OR NEW.name = '')
        AND (OLD.state <> 'active' OR OLD.concurrency < NEW.concurrency)
    ) EXECUTE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.publish_wake_v1()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER mesh_jobs_insert_wake
    AFTER INSERT ON mesh_jobs.jobs
    FOR EACH ROW WHEN (
        lower(current_setting('mesh_jobs.publish_wakeups', true)) IN ('on', 'true', '1')
        AND NEW.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND NEW.attempt < NEW.max_attempts
    ) EXECUTE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.publish_wake_v1()

-- Installed on PostgreSQL 17, whose MERGE RETURNING exposes the source ordinal.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.enqueue_batch_layout_v1() RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
    -- A column-scoped INSERT grant cannot take these locks directly. This
    -- helper only locks and inspects the fixed tables; the writes use invoker ACLs.
    LOCK TABLE ONLY mesh_jobs.admissions, ONLY mesh_jobs.queues,
        ONLY mesh_jobs.jobs, ONLY mesh_jobs.receipts
        IN ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.schema_version WHERE singleton AND version = 1) THEN
        RETURN false;
    END IF;

    -- Compare with schema.sql on PostgreSQL 17. In particular, a statement
    -- trigger fires even for a zero-row write, and a row trigger can inspect,
    -- change or suppress a job or receipt. Decide before issuing any batch DML.
    RETURN (WITH tables AS (
        SELECT c.*, a.amname, t.reloptions AS toast_options
        FROM pg_class c
        LEFT JOIN pg_am a ON a.oid = c.relam
        LEFT JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.reltoastrelid
        WHERE c.oid IN ('mesh_jobs.jobs'::regclass, 'mesh_jobs.queues'::regclass,
                        'mesh_jobs.receipts'::regclass, 'mesh_jobs.admissions'::regclass)
    ), layout(item) AS (
        SELECT jsonb_build_array('table', relname, relkind, relpersistence,
            amname, relrowsecurity, relforcerowsecurity, relispartition, relhassubclass,
            relhasrules, reloptions, toast_options) FROM tables
        UNION ALL
        SELECT jsonb_build_array('column', t.relname, a.attnum, a.attname,
            a.atttypid, a.atttypmod, a.attcollation, a.attnotnull, a.attidentity,
            a.attgenerated,
            -- Treat only the jobs argument's two supported physical formats
            -- as the same layout. Compression and all other fields still match.
            CASE WHEN t.oid = 'mesh_jobs.jobs'::regclass AND a.attname = 'args'
                      AND a.attstorage IN ('x', 'e') THEN 'x'::"char"
                 ELSE a.attstorage END,
            a.attcompression, a.attisdropped,
            pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid))
        FROM tables t JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum > 0
        LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
        UNION ALL
        SELECT jsonb_build_array('constraint', t.relname, c.conname, c.convalidated,
            pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid))
        FROM tables t JOIN pg_constraint c ON c.conrelid = t.oid
        UNION ALL
        SELECT jsonb_build_array('index', t.relname, i.indisvalid, i.indisready,
            pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid))
        FROM tables t JOIN pg_index i ON i.indrelid = t.oid
        UNION ALL
        SELECT jsonb_build_array('trigger', t.relname, tr.tgenabled,
            CASE WHEN tr.tgisinternal THEN tr.tgtype::text ELSE pg_get_triggerdef(tr.oid) END)
        FROM tables t JOIN pg_trigger tr ON tr.tgrelid = t.oid
        UNION ALL
        SELECT jsonb_build_array('function', pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))
        FROM pg_proc p
        WHERE p.oid IN ('mesh_jobs.enqueue(text,jsonb,text,text)'::regprocedure,
                        'mesh_jobs.now_ms()'::regprocedure,
                        'mesh_jobs.effect_key(mesh_jobs.jobs)'::regprocedure,
                        'mesh_jobs.publish_wake_v1()'::regprocedure,
                        'mesh_jobs.fence_claim_v1()'::regprocedure)
    )
    SELECT md5(string_agg(item::text, E'\n' ORDER BY item::text COLLATE "C")) = 'd40b27c60eed17d561be929bc792f074'
    FROM layout);
END
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.unique_values(payload jsonb, keys jsonb) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
    SELECT CASE WHEN keys = '[]' THEN payload ELSE coalesce((
        SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k, payload -> k)
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(keys) AS k
        WHERE payload ? k
    ), '{}'::jsonb) END
$$

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mesh_jobs_unique_key
    ON mesh_jobs.jobs (namespace, unique_key) WHERE unique_key IS NOT NULL

-- Only fully reaped successful outcomes are eligible. Omitted ordinals use
-- scalar settlement, including cancellation and expired or replaced leases.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.complete_batch_v1(
    ns text, ids uuid[], tokens uuid[]
) RETURNS TABLE(ordinal bigint)
LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
    WITH held AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.id, j.lease_token, j.lease_expires_at_ms, p.ordinal
        FROM unnest(ids, tokens) WITH ORDINALITY AS p(id, token, ordinal)
        JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j ON j.namespace = ns AND (j.id, j.lease_token) = (p.id, p.token)
        WHERE cardinality(ids) = cardinality(tokens) AND cardinality(ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
            AND j.state = 'executing' AND j.cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL
        FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), checked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT h.*, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS finished_at FROM held h
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'completed', finished_at_ms = h.finished_at,
            lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at_ms = NULL
        FROM checked h WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = h.id AND j.lease_token = h.lease_token
            AND h.lease_expires_at_ms > h.finished_at
        RETURNING h.ordinal
    )
    SELECT c.ordinal FROM completed c
$$
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION mesh_jobs.complete_batch_v1(text,uuid[],uuid[]) FROM PUBLIC
SET ROLE parity_subject

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER mesh_jobs_update_wake
    AFTER UPDATE OF queue, worker, version, state, attempt, max_attempts, scheduled_at_ms ON mesh_jobs.jobs
    FOR EACH ROW WHEN (
        lower(current_setting('mesh_jobs.publish_wakeups', true)) IN ('on', 'true', '1')
        AND NEW.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND NEW.attempt < NEW.max_attempts
        AND (OLD.state NOT IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') OR OLD.attempt >= OLD.max_attempts
             OR (OLD.queue, OLD.worker, OLD.version, OLD.scheduled_at_ms)
                IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.queue, NEW.worker, NEW.version, NEW.scheduled_at_ms))
    ) EXECUTE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.publish_wake_v1()

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mesh_jobs_cron_reboot

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mesh_jobs.receipts (
    namespace text NOT NULL,
    request_key text NOT NULL,
    fingerprint text NOT NULL,
    receipt jsonb NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (namespace, request_key)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mesh_jobs.queues (
    namespace text NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL,
    concurrency integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (concurrency BETWEEN 0 AND 1024),
    state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (state IN ('active', 'paused', 'stopped')),
    PRIMARY KEY (namespace, name)
)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.enqueue_batch_v1(ns text, batch jsonb)
RETURNS TABLE(ordinal text, receipt text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
    processed integer;
BEGIN
    -- The caller holds the same namespace fence as scalar and older producers.
    -- Ordinal zero is reserved for this branch, before the first batch write.
    IF jsonb_array_length(batch) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 128
       OR NOT mesh_jobs.enqueue_batch_layout_v1()
       OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch) x
                  WHERE x->'spec'->'unique' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
                     OR x->'spec'->'replace' IS DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch) x
                  WHERE x->>'request_key' <> ''
                  GROUP BY x->>'request_key' HAVING count(*) > 1)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch) x JOIN mesh_jobs.receipts r
                  ON r.namespace = ns AND r.request_key = x->>'request_key'
                  WHERE x->>'request_key' <> '') THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT '0'::text, 'stock'::text;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO mesh_jobs.queues(namespace, name)
    SELECT ns, x.value->'spec'->>'queue'
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, i)
    GROUP BY x.value->'spec'->>'queue' ORDER BY min(x.i)
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH inserted AS (
        MERGE INTO mesh_jobs.jobs j USING (
            SELECT x.i, x.value->'spec' AS s, x.value->>'request_key' AS rk,
                x.value->>'fingerprint' AS fp, mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS ts
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch) WITH ORDINALITY AS x(value, i)
            ORDER BY x.i
        ) input ON false
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (
            namespace, worker, version, queue, args, metadata, tags, state, priority,
            max_attempts, timeout_ms, backoff_base_ms, backoff_max_ms,
            inserted_at_ms, scheduled_at_ms, unique_key
        ) VALUES (
            ns, s->>'worker', (s->>'version')::bigint, s->>'queue',
            s->'args', s->'metadata', s->'tags',
            CASE WHEN (s->>'suspended')::boolean THEN 'suspended'
                WHEN coalesce((s->>'scheduled_at_ms')::bigint, ts + coalesce((s->>'delay_ms')::bigint, 0)) > ts
                THEN 'scheduled' ELSE 'available' END,
            (s->>'priority')::integer, (s->>'max_attempts')::integer, (s->>'timeout_ms')::bigint,
            (s->>'backoff_base_ms')::bigint, (s->>'backoff_max_ms')::bigint,
            ts, coalesce((s->>'scheduled_at_ms')::bigint, ts + coalesce((s->>'delay_ms')::bigint, 0)),
            NULL
        )
        RETURNING input.i, input.rk, input.fp, jsonb_build_object(
            'id', j.id, 'effect_key', mesh_jobs.effect_key(j), 'state', j.state,
            'conflict', false, 'inserted', true
        ) AS result
    ), saved AS (
        INSERT INTO mesh_jobs.receipts(namespace, request_key, fingerprint, receipt)
        SELECT ns, i.rk, i.fp, i.result FROM inserted i WHERE i.rk <> '' ORDER BY i.i
        RETURNING request_key
    )
    SELECT i.i::text, i.result::text FROM inserted i LEFT JOIN saved r ON r.request_key = i.rk
    WHERE i.rk = '' OR r.request_key IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY i.i;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS processed = ROW_COUNT;
    IF processed <> jsonb_array_length(batch) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'mesh jobs incomplete set-based enqueue';
    END IF;
END
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.claim_batch_set_v1(
    ns text, queue_name text, workers jsonb, lease_ms bigint, slots integer, cutoff_ms bigint
) RETURNS TABLE(status text, id text, token text, context text, timeout_ms text, context_bytes text)
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp SET lock_timeout = '100ms' AS $$
DECLARE
    q mesh_jobs.queues%ROWTYPE;
    remaining integer := least(coalesce(slots, 0), 16);
    due_at bigint;
BEGIN
    IF lease_ms IS NULL OR lease_ms NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 31536000000 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'mesh jobs admitted claim lease_ms must be positive and at most 365 days';
    END IF;
    IF remaining <= 0 THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed'
        OR current_setting('client_encoding') <> current_setting('server_encoding') THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT 'fallback'::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- Serialize with single claims, cursor batches and queue controls.
    -- Namespace pause takes its advisory lock first. Never wait for it
    -- while holding a queue row, including when a legacy claimant is present.
    SELECT * INTO q FROM mesh_jobs.queues
    WHERE namespace = ns AND name = queue_name FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR q.state <> 'active' OR q.concurrency = 0 THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended(ns, 1782495106)) THEN RETURN; END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues WHERE namespace = ns AND name = '' AND state = 'paused')
    THEN RETURN; END IF;

    -- This command takes a fresh snapshot after acquiring the capacity lock.
    remaining := least(remaining, q.concurrency - (SELECT count(*) FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name AND j.state = 'executing'));
    IF remaining <= 0 THEN RETURN; END IF;

    due_at := coalesce(cutoff_ms, mesh_jobs.now_ms());
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT j.* FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
        ORDER BY j.priority, j.scheduled_at_ms, j.position
        LIMIT remaining FOR NO KEY UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
    ), rendered AS MATERIALIZED (
        -- Keep speculative memory bounded before detoasting. Compressed and
        -- larger values go to the released exact-prefix cursor on a new turn.
        SELECT p.id, p.priority, p.scheduled_at_ms, p.position, p.timeout_ms,
            gen_random_uuid() AS grant_token,
            CASE WHEN pg_column_size(p.args)::bigint + pg_column_size(p.metadata)
                    + pg_column_size(p.tags) <= 65536
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.args) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.metadata) IS NULL
                    AND pg_column_compression(p.tags) IS NULL
                    AND octet_length(p.worker) + octet_length(p.queue) <= 1024
            THEN jsonb_build_object(
                'id', p.id, 'effect_key', p.id::text || '/' || p.run::text, 'worker', p.worker,
                'version', p.version, 'args', p.args, 'attempt', p.attempt + 1,
                'max_attempts', p.max_attempts, 'queue', p.queue, 'metadata', p.metadata,
                'tags', p.tags, 'scheduled_at_ms', p.scheduled_at_ms
            )::text END AS body
        FROM picked p
    ), sized AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT r.*, octet_length(r.body) AS bytes FROM rendered r
    ), budget AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT coalesce(bool_and(s.bytes IS NOT NULL AND s.bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
                     AND sum(s.bytes + 128) <= 32 * 1024 * 1024 - 1024, true) AS fits,
               mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS started_at
        FROM sized s
    ), granted AS (
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'executing', attempt = j.attempt + 1,
            attempted_at_ms = b.started_at, lease_token = s.grant_token,
            lease_expires_at_ms = b.started_at + lease_ms
        FROM sized s, budget b WHERE b.fits AND j.namespace = ns AND j.id = s.id
        RETURNING j.id AS job_id, s.grant_token, s.body, s.timeout_ms, s.bytes,
                  s.priority, s.scheduled_at_ms, s.position
    )
    SELECT 'claimed'::text, g.job_id::text, g.grant_token::text, g.body, g.timeout_ms::text, g.bytes::text
    FROM granted g ORDER BY g.priority, g.scheduled_at_ms, g.position;

    IF FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;
    -- The speculative transaction made no state transitions. Determine whether
    -- exact sizing or a busy eligible row needs the existing claim protocol.
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
        WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.queue = queue_name
            AND j.state IN ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable') AND j.scheduled_at_ms <= due_at
            AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
            AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset(workers) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                        WHERE (w.worker, w.version) = (j.worker, j.version))
            AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.batch_context_blocks b
                WHERE b.namespace = j.namespace AND b.id = j.id
                    AND b.row_version = j.xmin AND b.row_location = j.ctid
                    AND b.encoding = current_setting('client_encoding')::name)
    ) THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT 'fallback'::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text;
    ELSE
        -- Use the exact scan cutoff to cover a deadline crossing after this
        -- transaction and before the separate next-due read.
        RETURN QUERY SELECT 'empty'::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, due_at::text, NULL::text;
    END IF;
END
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.queue_json(q mesh_jobs.queues) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql STABLE STRICT SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'queue', q.name, 'concurrency', q.concurrency, 'state', q.state,
        'running', (SELECT count(*) FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j
                    WHERE j.namespace = q.namespace AND j.queue = q.name AND j.state = 'executing'))
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.recover(ns text, page_size integer, queue_filter jsonb) RETURNS bigint
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
    job record;
    recovered bigint := 0;
    cutoff bigint := mesh_jobs.now_ms();
BEGIN
    FOR job IN SELECT id, lease_token FROM mesh_jobs.jobs
        WHERE namespace = ns AND state = 'executing' AND lease_expires_at_ms <= cutoff
            AND (queue_filter IS NULL OR queue_filter ? queue)
        ORDER BY lease_expires_at_ms, id LIMIT page_size FOR NO KEY UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LOOP
        IF mesh_jobs.settle(ns, job.id, job.lease_token,
            '{"action":"fail","reason":"lease expired"}'::jsonb, true)
        THEN recovered := recovered + 1; END IF;
    END LOOP;

    WITH due AS (
        SELECT id FROM mesh_jobs.jobs
        WHERE namespace = ns AND state IN ('scheduled', 'retryable') AND scheduled_at_ms <= cutoff
            AND (queue_filter IS NULL OR queue_filter ? queue)
        ORDER BY scheduled_at_ms, id LIMIT page_size FOR NO KEY UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    )
    UPDATE mesh_jobs.jobs j SET state = 'available'
    FROM due WHERE j.namespace = ns AND j.id = due.id;
    RETURN recovered;
END
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.now_ms() RETURNS bigint
LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
    SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint
$$

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mesh_jobs.jobs (
    namespace text NOT NULL,
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(),
    position bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    run bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (run > 0),
    worker text NOT NULL,
    version bigint NOT NULL CHECK (version BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295),
    queue text NOT NULL,
    args jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(args) = 'object'),
    metadata jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object'),
    tags jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(tags) = 'array'),
    state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN
        ('available', 'scheduled', 'retryable', 'suspended', 'executing',
         'completed', 'cancelled', 'discarded')),
    priority integer NOT NULL CHECK (priority BETWEEN 0 AND 9),
    attempt integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt BETWEEN 0 AND max_attempts),
    max_attempts integer NOT NULL CHECK (max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    timeout_ms bigint NOT NULL CHECK (timeout_ms > 0),
    backoff_base_ms bigint NOT NULL CHECK (backoff_base_ms >= 0),
    backoff_max_ms bigint NOT NULL CHECK (backoff_max_ms >= backoff_base_ms),
    inserted_at_ms bigint NOT NULL,
    scheduled_at_ms bigint NOT NULL,
    attempted_at_ms bigint,
    finished_at_ms bigint,
    lease_token uuid,
    lease_expires_at_ms bigint,
    cancel_requested_at_ms bigint,
    errors jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (jsonb_typeof(errors) = 'array'),
    unique_key text,
    PRIMARY KEY (namespace, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (namespace, queue) REFERENCES mesh_jobs.queues(namespace, name),
    CHECK ((state = 'executing') = (lease_token IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (state <> 'executing' OR attempt > 0),
    CHECK ((state = 'executing') = (lease_expires_at_ms IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (state = 'executing' OR cancel_requested_at_ms IS NULL),
    CHECK ((state IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'discarded')) = (finished_at_ms IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW mesh_jobs.queue_summaries AS
    SELECT q.namespace, q.name AS queue, q.concurrency, q.state,
        EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues paused WHERE paused.namespace = q.namespace
            AND paused.name = '' AND paused.state = 'paused') AS namespace_paused,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM mesh_jobs.jobs j WHERE j.namespace = q.namespace
            AND j.queue = q.name AND j.state = 'executing') AS running
    FROM mesh_jobs.queues q WHERE q.name <> ''

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mesh_jobs.queue_control(
    ns text, queue_name text, operation text, capacity integer
) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
    q mesh_jobs.queues%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    IF operation = 'configure' OR operation = 'start' THEN
        INSERT INTO mesh_jobs.queues(namespace, name, concurrency)
            VALUES (ns, queue_name, coalesce(capacity, 1))
        ON CONFLICT (namespace, name) DO UPDATE SET
            concurrency = coalesce(capacity, queues.concurrency),
            state = CASE WHEN operation = 'start' THEN 'active' ELSE queues.state END
        RETURNING * INTO q;
    ELSE
        UPDATE mesh_jobs.queues SET
            concurrency = CASE WHEN operation = 'scale' THEN capacity ELSE concurrency END,
            state = CASE operation
                WHEN 'pause' THEN CASE WHEN state = 'active' THEN 'paused' ELSE state END
                WHEN 'resume' THEN CASE WHEN state = 'paused' THEN 'active' ELSE state END
                WHEN 'stop' THEN 'stopped'
                ELSE state END
        WHERE namespace = ns AND name = queue_name RETURNING * INTO q;
    END IF;
    RETURN coalesce(mesh_jobs.queue_json(q), 'null'::jsonb);
END
$$
